published_ranges._ams: 95A TPU: not AMS-compatible by Bambu's guidance; feed from external spool.
published_ranges._notes: The product page now links the 'TPU 2.0' TDS (header Version 5.1 Jul 2024): improved printability and less stringing at high speed; melt index 4.5 g/10min (210C 1.2kg); elongation 332%; cooling fan on; textured PEI or blue tape. That PDF has overlapping text layers; values taken from its plain-text layer. The older TPU TDS v5.1 gives 210-230C, 20-40 mm/s, retraction 1-3 mm @ 20-40 mm/s, overhang threshold 35 deg.

conflicts: Nozzle: older OVERTURE TPU TDS v5.1 (https://overture3d.com/cdn/shop/files/OVERTURE_TPU_TDS_EN_V5.1_195e4c18-e1da-47fc-964f-a651a96edc78.pdf) and the product page say 210-230C; current TPU 2.0 TDS says 210-240C (kept).
Print speed: older TPU TDS v5.1 says 20-40 mm/s; TPU 2.0 TDS says 200 mm/s.
